title: Chrome browsing history
whyItMatters: Lists every page visited, when, how often and what was typed into the address bar. It shows health, money, relationship and work interests in detail.
source: Chromium user data directory docs, profile files include History: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: One History file per profile. Chrome may also leave History-journal and History-wal next to it. Looked for on this PC: exists (Default profile).

cleanup.exportFirst: Export bookmarks from Chrome Bookmark manager if you want to keep the sites you saved.
steps: In Chrome, open Settings > Privacy and security and delete browsing data.
Delete the history file named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes local visit history for every Chrome profile on this PC; signed-in sync can copy it back until sync is turned off.
cleanup.source: Google Chrome Help, Delete browsing data in Chrome: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95582
